objs.name: document
objs.description: Core managed object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other document types that go through creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving lifecycles.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchy level in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in the document naming convention (e.g. RL).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Free-text title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable duration for validity checks, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable duration for archived documents, default 10 years.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity assigned to the document.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: Client(s) in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document linked to a main document; released together with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the attachment, following the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Non-controlled supplementary information added to a document, not subject to the release cycle.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional information is published.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal to amend an existing released document, created by any author and tracked until completion.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, processed via workflow.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate (put out of force) a document and archive it, processed via workflow.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to reactivate an archived/invalidated document, created by the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person who participates in document management processes in various roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Named group of users used to assign read or other authorizations and distribution list membership.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Type or purpose of the group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Configuration of user groups and persons to be notified or required to acknowledge upon document release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance that routes tasks through defined steps (e.g. Creator, Review, Release) with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Translation Release, Acknowledgement).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow instance.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Recorded signature of a workflow participant confirming completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who signed.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step to which the signature pertains.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents.

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Name of the template.

attributes.name: associated_document_type
attributes.description: Document type for which the template is available.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational entity (e.g. department, location) to which documents can be linked.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the organizational unit.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Business process to which documents can be linked for process-specific filing.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the process.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The document type selected at creation.

attributes.name: template_used
attributes.description: The template selected, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in a local Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata or attributes of a document are maintained or changed via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts the saved document to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval workflow (Creator–Review–Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the Creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness and completes the review step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document, completing the release workflow and publishing the document.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling subsequent workflow steps.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, or attachment modifications.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: edit_attachment
evts.description: Content or properties of an existing attachment are modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Non-controlled additional information is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is removed from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for a released document, notifying the document author by e-mail.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of a change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system generates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's Valid Until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension request is processed via workflow; participants confirm or reject extended validity.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Validity is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: process_override_request
evts.description: The override request is processed via workflow with review and release steps.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, rights are revoked (except archive group), and the archive duration begins.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation workflow is executed by the initiator to restore the document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document and its attachments are restored to a new version with original metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual users for a document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are added to or removed from a document's distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Upon release, e-mail notifications are sent to users and user groups on the distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, acknowledgement workflow tasks are sent to users and user groups requiring active confirmation.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document via the workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is checked and released via a dedicated translation approval workflow.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: An external file is uploaded to an existing document object cover.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, archived documents are permanently deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An Attachment is a controlled sub-document that belongs to a main Document.
Additional Info is supplementary information attached to a Document.
A Change Proposal is created for and linked to a specific Document.
A Validity Extension Request is linked to the Document whose validity is being checked.
An Override Request is created for a specific Document to be invalidated.
A Reactivation Request references the archived Document to be reactivated.
A Document can reference another Document (e.g. local extension referencing original, or cross-references).
A Document can be linked to a Process for process-specific filing.
A Document can be linked to an Organizational Unit.
A Document Template is associated with a document type and used when creating a Document.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document for notification and acknowledgement.
A Distribution List contains User Groups for distribution.
A Distribution List can contain individual Users.
A User is a member of one or more User Groups.
